confirmedDecisions: Athlete and Coach are first-class v1 users; coach access requires explicit athlete assignment.
Post-session capture uses mandatory RPE plus expectation match, optional pain, structured deviation reason and optional free comment.
v1 performance tests include RowErg 500m, 1000m, 2000m, 5000m, 30min, RowErg lactate, bike lactate and a configurable staged protocol.
Self-service export is MVP scope; complete deletion/retention is required before broader multi-user rollout.
Athlete Second Brain is contract-ready only in v1; no automatic persistence.

requirements.statement: Authenticate all users through Authentik and authorize Athlete and Coach roles inside the application.
Permit a Coach to access only explicitly assigned athletes and audit every cross-athlete action.
Capture perceived difficulty relative to plan expectation, optional pain, structured deviation reason and optional comment.
Support structured RowErg and bike lactate step tests plus a configurable staged protocol.
Distinguish measured, derived and assumed/estimated test values with provenance.
Provide self-service athlete data export in MVP.
Treat complete deletion/retention behavior as a production release gate before broader multi-user rollout.
Prepare a governed Athlete Second-Brain contract boundary without automatic v1 persistence.

nonGoals: Garmin Connect cloud OAuth in MVP
risks: Coach access expands authorization and privacy scope and therefore requires explicit assignment checks on every athlete-scoped endpoint.
Current app-local plan package can drift from canonical Skillz plan semantics without a versioned adapter.
Subjective athlete journal entries must not be silently overwritten by coaches or device imports.

aiMlReadiness.summary: MVP is deterministic and manual-first. Structured adaptation handoff export is created before embedded LLM integration. Any future model runs in proposal/shadow mode first; hard safety and authorization boundaries remain deterministic; plan mutation always requires explicit human action.

routingReason: All material product decisions are confirmed and technical wayfinding is already complete.
